breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions (Dirichlet and Periodic). The ground truth removed the periodic condition. The agent correctly identified this conflict and generated a specification that states, 'Enforce Dirichlet boundary conditions only: u=0 on the entire boundary of the domain,' which successfully resolves the inconsistency in line with the ground truth.
